question: Q-N-M2-D4
text: For trips picked up at JFK Airport in 2024, fare per mile by dropoff borough and payment type; which combination is highest?
interpretation: Trips picked up at JFK Airport in 2024: fare per mile by dropoff borough x payment type; is_highest marks the highest combination (ties: borough, payment type).
assemble: WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM q WHERE trips > 0), top_c AS (SELECT dropoff_borough, payment_type_name FROM c ORDER BY fare_per_mile DESC, dropoff_borough, payment_type_name LIMIT 1) SELECT c.dropoff_borough, c.payment_type_name, c.trips, c.fare_per_mile, c.dropoff_borough = t.dropoff_borough AND c.payment_type_name = t.payment_type_name AS is_highest FROM c CROSS JOIN top_c t ORDER BY c.dropoff_borough, c.payment_type_name
